step1_analysis.description: A two-stage non-inverting CMOS buffer featuring a shrunk logic swing output. The second stage utilizes a diode-connected NMOS pull-up (XM7) to limit the low-level voltage swing (V_OL > 0), reducing the overall voltage swing for lower power consumption and faster subsequent sensing.

paper_reference.title: A 0.8-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative Two-Level CMOS Cache Memory Using Two-Stage Wordline/Bitline-Oriented Tag-Compare (WLOTC/BLOTC) Scheme

v_ol.description: Low logic level of the output (Shrunk Logic Swing)

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating the currents of the pull-down NMOS (XM3) in the linear region and the pull-up NMOS (XM7) in saturation. With VDD=1.8V and Vth=0.42V, solving 0.5*(1.8-V_OL-0.42)^2 = (1.8-0.42)*V_OL - 0.5*V_OL^2 yields V_OL ≈ 0.4V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS pull-up prevents the output from fully discharging to 0V, creating the shrunk logic swing characteristic described in the paper.

v_oh.description: High logic level of the output

sky130_expected.calculation: When N1 is low, PMOS XM2 is fully on and pulls N0 to VDD.

delay_rise.description: Propagation delay from input rise to output rise

sky130_expected.calculation: Two gate delays in 130nm technology at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The buffer is unloaded in this testbench, so the delay will be very small, dominated by intrinsic parasitic capacitances.

delay_fall.description: Propagation delay from input fall to output fall

sky130_expected.calculation: Two gate delays in 130nm technology at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Similar to rise delay, but slightly affected by the contention between XM3 and XM7 during pull-down.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C*V^2*f plus short-circuit power. The shrunk logic swing reduces dynamic power, but the contention between XM3 and XM7 introduces static power when output is low.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled to 1.8V and 50MHz, the static current during the low output state will dominate the power consumption.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the shrunk logic swing levels (V_OL, V_OH), propagation delays, and average power consumption of the SLS buffer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Shrunk Logic Swing Buffer Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.8

* Input signal: 50MHz -> 20ns period
VIN N3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 9.8n 20n)

XM1 N1 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 VDD VDD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
tran 0.1n 100n

* Measure V_OH and V_OL
meas tran v_oh max v(N0) from=10n to=20n
meas tran v_ol min v(N0) from=20n to=30n

* Measure delays (midpoint of 1.8V and 0.4V is ~1.1V)
meas tran delay_rise trig v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.1 rise=1
meas tran delay_fall trig v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=1.1 fall=1

* Measure power
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=100n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
